article.title: Designation of any statutory authority or body to function as Central Authority.
article.content: The Central Government may, if it considers necessary, by notification, designate any statutory authority or body to exercise the powers and perform the functions of the Central Authority referred to in section 10.
article.html:
23Designation of any statutory authority or body to function as Central Authority.

Section 23 · Chapter III · page 17 of the Act

The Central Government may, if it considers necessary, by notification, designate any statutory authority or body to exercise the powers and perform the functions of the Central Authority referred to in section 10.
